address_rule: New actual PT_LOAD load bias plus listed ELF address; never reuse r10 absolute addresses. Each mapped instance pinned by SHA/dev/inode and segment coverage.

points.meaning: Exact bridge_symbol returned x0 at3bbc and moved it to x2 at3bc0; this event observes the real nonnull dlsym result used by this invocation, not a new dlsym query. Tail branch has already restored original caller LR and SP.
points.filter: validated caller return_PC in exact player executable PT_LOAD and player fromSurface GOT selects this libandroid instance

points.meaning: Observe before the caller executes the instruction at original return_PC. This is the same invocation; fixed libandroid3bd8/3be0 is NOT a successful-return hook because the successful path tail-calls winner.

points.filter: validated exact player caller and player lock GOT selects this shim instance
points.meaning: Record actual argument, not a pointer parsed from an earlier log; original hard -19 path remains unchanged.

Conservatively invalidate association on any observed release of the tracked pointer, regardless of caller. Release need not destroy it; an invalidated association is UNKNOWN, not a free/corruption claim.
Records missing-symbol branch, if it occurs. Not required for a successful fromSurface/lock chain.

wrapper_snapshot.strategy: Capture during the observed invocation boundary while relevant threads are stopped consistently. A late asynchronous memory read does not meet this proposal. No injected function calls or raw-pointer dereference inside target.
wrapper_snapshot.first_read: +0 uint32, exact size/rc and readable mapping
if_first_magic_matches: +0xc0 uint64 OH pointer, record as opaque until both magic checks pass
wrapper_snapshot.if_mismatch: NON_ADAPTER_AT_THIS_EVENT; +c0 not interpreted as OH pointer. Does not prove raw OH, dangling pointer or corruption.
wrapper_snapshot.if_read_error: UNKNOWN; no EFAULT masking, no zero fill, no speculative unwrapping

correlation.fromSurface: same tid/call sequence and captured return_PC/SP; nesting must be tracked or explicitly refused
correlation.lock: may occur on another thread. Match exact pointer plus last observed generation, matched wrapper snapshots and no observed intervening release/new-return of same address. A gap or missed event makes association UNKNOWN.
correlation.separate_calls: fromSurface and lock are not one C invocation; report their two boundary records and generation link, not a fictitious atomic combined call.

winner_evidence: Map captured x2 to exact mapped instance PT_LOAD, SHA/inode and ELF symbol/offset. If it is a11c9154+807238, say so; otherwise identify actual bytes. d720 is a loader handle, never a code-address proof.

bounds.scope: one exact child, first useful fromSurface-to-lock chain; stop on identity/mapping drift
bounds.incomplete: NOT_REACHED/UNKNOWN, no extra launch policy introduced

invariants: No replacement of system liblog/libandroid or global WebView behavior in this observation proposal
No new dlsym/dlopen/oh_anw_get_oh call on the target; no refcount changes or target-memory modification
Preserve original arguments, return value, errno, and invocation count; externally buffered records only
A tracing backend may pause threads or alter debug registers/timing. It must be separately selected/reviewed; this is not an ordinary passive file-read plan or a playback/performance test
No binary patch/trap fallback silently introduced if read-only execution tracing is unavailable
next_decision: Confirmed AdapterAnw plus raw-OH consumer requires caller-scoped unwrap across geometry and paired buffer operations while keeping wrapper reference ownership; valid raw-OH input needs separate provenance. Neither native_ready nor successful binding proves usable geometry or video playback.
